'''Blood spites''' were [[Bat/Legends|bat-like]] creatures that fed on warm [[Blood/Legends|blood]] and inhabited the [[Old City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], deep in the [[Red Desert]]. Their existence was widely considered to be only a rumor by the [[Je'daii]], though they were very much real as [[Lanoree Brock]] would discover as she entered the city in pursuit of her brother, [[Dalien Brock|Dalien]].

==Biology and appearance==
Blood spites had dripping [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], long and thin tendrils that were easy to break, and flew using feathery wings that made no noise. Most aspects of its body were light and airy, except for its hard teeth, which produced [[Sap/Legends|sap]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
